A.staff: Kai and Pono (instructors) and the beach stand

pf.license.need: none from the state for surf lessons in most places; each instructor holds a current lifeguard or first-aid card the business says is current; where a city or park permits commercial lessons on its beach, the permit is the business's own word, shown only once the owner says it is on file
pf.license.who: the business, for its registration and any beach permit; each instructor, for their own lifeguard or first-aid card
pf.license.ask: the business registration; any beach permit, with the beaches and dates it covers; each instructor's card and its end date
pf.license.check: Rosie checks no card, license or permit: each one is the business's own word, shown as that, never as a state license or as checked
pf.license.scope: an instructor is offered only for the beaches and lesson types the owner says they may teach
pf.license.blocks: goes live on identity and the business's registration; an instructor is offered once the owner says yes
pf.license.renewals: cards reminded 30 and 7 days before; a card the owner reports lapsed takes that instructor off new lessons
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it is sent
pf.license.background: background checks for instructors who teach children, where the rules ask: the business's own word

pf.services.shape: class: seats in a scheduled lesson on the beach, each surfer with their own spot and their own code; a private lesson books one instructor for one person or a family; at a customer's place (flow B) the instructor goes to the beach the group picks
pf.services.examples: the example school's own prices (Lee Surf School and Lee Surf Lessons), not a standard

list.name: Group beginner lesson (90 min, board and wetsuit lent)
Private lesson (60 min, one instructor)
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee, paid at the beach stand
list.after: at the stand, the rest is paid
list.capacity: one or two people, one instructor

list.name: Kids group lesson (ages 8 to 12, a parent on the sand)
list.note: a parent or guardian books and signs; children under 8 need a parent on the sand

list.name: Private lesson at a rental house or hotel (up to 4 people)
list.where: at the customer's place, then the beach they pick (flow B)
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee
list.after: the saved card charged when the instructor texts DONE

list.name: Beach party lesson (up to 6 people)
list.where: at a beach the customer picks, where the city allows lessons (flow B)
list.note: the beach permit where it asks for one, booked ahead; big surf: a new time or a full refund

pf.services.intro: the free beach look: nothing is taken; it's an instructor's talk on the sand before any lesson, booked by text
pf.services.capacity: spots per lesson set by the instructor's limit (8 surfers per instructor); a second instructor adds spots
pf.services.minimum: a group lesson runs with 3, counted 24 hours before; too few: Sam runs it or cancels, and each surfer gets a full refund or another time
pf.services.waitlist: a full lesson keeps a waitlist; a freed spot goes by text to one person at a time
pf.services.skills: surf and paddle lessons, kids' lessons, private lessons, beach permits by beach
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the surfer must be there

beforeTimes: how many surfers, and their ages (children's lessons are for ages 8 to 12)
has the surfer tried surfing or paddling before (sets the level and the group)
for a lesson at a customer's place: the address, the beach they want and the area
afterTime: board and wetsuit sizes, to lend
anything the instructor should know: a fear of the water, a health need, a language
securePage: each surfer's name, age and a waiver, read and signed
health notes: heart, asthma, a seizure or a recent surgery, and any medicine they carry
a swimming level the instructor should know
for a child: the parent or guardian's OK and who may pick them up
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child under 18 (children 8 to 12 in group lessons; teens 13 to 17 with a guardian's OK); children under 8 are booked with a parent on the sand
pf.questions.told: the beach, the meeting point, the length, that surf conditions decide the day, and what to bring

stop.words: someone not breathing or unresponsive in the water right now, or a child who can't get a breath
stop.say: Call 911 now. Start rescue breathing or CPR, and call for the lifeguard.

goOn.words: a heart condition, asthma, a recent surgery, or pregnancy
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the instructor reads it before the lesson; Rosie gives no health advice

goOn.words: a surfer afraid of the water
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the instructor starts on the sand, and nobody is pushed into the water

pf.safety.inWater: a surfer swallows water or is in trouble: the instructor lifts them out and checks breathing; 911 for trouble breathing; the instructor's first-aid steps follow; Sam is told

steps.name: Waiver on the secure page
steps.who: every surfer; a parent or guardian signs for a child
steps.result: not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Health questions on the secure page
steps.result: the booking goes on; any yes is read by the instructor before the lesson, on the secure page

steps.name: Surf conditions check
steps.when: by 7am the day of the lesson
steps.result: unsafe surf: the lesson is called off, and the customer picks a new time or a full refund

pf.first_steps.prep: a swimsuit, sunscreen, water and a rash guard; arrive 15 minutes early for the board and wetsuit; a photo ID for the first lesson

pf.visit.checkIn: the instructor ticks each surfer at the beach stand, or takes each surfer's own code
pf.visit.lateEntry: a late surfer joins until 10 minutes after the start; after that the spot may go to someone waiting, and the lesson ends on time
pf.visit.changes: an extra hour or a private add-on is priced first, and the surfer says yes; nothing is added to a group lesson
pf.visit.leaveEarly: a surfer who leaves early pays the full price: the spot was theirs
pf.visit.done: the instructor texts DONE at the end of the lesson

pf.money.before: a group lesson, a kids' lesson and a paddle session paid in full when booking; a private lesson at the beach: a card saved for the $40 fee, paid at the beach stand; a lesson at a customer's place: a card saved for the $40 fee, charged when the instructor texts DONE; a beach party paid in full
pf.money.after: everything is settled before, or at DONE on the saved card; nothing is billed later
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel or move up to 24 hours before (the school's setting); later, or a no-show, the price may be kept only with the owner's yes
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: the $40 fee on a private lesson, the price on a group; the owner confirms each fee; no answer in 24 hours means no fee
pf.money.makeups: when the school calls a lesson off for surf or weather: a full refund or another time, never a fee
pf.money.caps: deposits within the state's limits where they apply
pf.money.tax: any sales tax the state requires, in the price before the yes
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many surfers

pf.messages.never: health notes, injuries, a child's name and age in texts to anyone but the parent: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the instructor's day list shows the lesson and the number of surfers; names open on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent or guardian who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each instructor's lifeguard or first-aid card, the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
pf.staff.skills: surf and paddle lessons, kids' lessons, private lessons; the beaches each instructor knows; children's lessons only with instructors the owner says may teach children
pf.staff.ratio: up to 8 surfers per instructor; children's lessons at 4 per instructor
pf.staff.standIn: another instructor who knows the beach and the lesson; a private customer who named an instructor is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs beach parties, private add-ons and refunds

pf.rules.showFacts: the beach, the meeting point, the length, that surf decides the day, and the cancel terms before the yes; any beach permit the city asks for
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for a lesson already given
pf.rules.waiver: what a waiver may say, where the state limits it; the state form sets the words
pf.rules.minors: children with a parent or guardian on the booking; a child is never left with staff without the parent's OK on file
pf.rules.records: waivers and health notes kept with the booking for 7 years, or longer where the state asks
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the lesson

pf.edges.surf: high surf, a red-flag day or lightning: the instructor or Sam calls the lesson off by 7am the day of, or at the beach; a full refund or another time, the customer picks
pf.edges.tooFew: too few by 24 hours before: Sam runs it or cancels; each surfer gets a full refund or another time
pf.edges.late: a late surfer joins until 10 minutes after the start; after that the spot goes to someone waiting
pf.edges.instructorOut: another certified instructor covers the same lesson at the same time
pf.edges.childLeaves: a child leaves the group: the instructor keeps the rest together, calls the parent at once, and only a listed adult takes the child
pf.edges.unwell: a surfer looks unwell: the instructor stops the lesson, gives first aid, calls 911 if it's serious, and Sam is told; nothing about it goes in a text
pf.edges.minors: a child is picked up by a listed adult; a teen (13 to 17) may leave only when the guardian's OK says so
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
